Looking for a flexible driving job in Roosendaal? Join Albert Heijn Online through Consolid and earn €18.83 gross per hour. Wat bieden wij? €18.83 gross per hour (all-in) including holiday allowance and shift allowances; 25 paid vacation days (full-time basis); Pension scheme from your first working day; Travel reimbursement up to 45 km from the depot; Flexible contract between 12 and 32 hours per week; Choose your own availability; Comprehensive three-day buddy training programme; Employee grocery discount with the Albert Heijn bonus card; Independent work with plenty of customer interaction and long-term opportunities. Functieomschrijving Grocery Delivery Driver Roosendaal | Independent Job | Flexible Hours Your shift starts at the Albert Heijn Online depot at Paardenblok 1 in Roosendaal. You collect your handheld scanner, receive your delivery route and carefully load the grocery crates into your delivery van. You will independently deliver groceries to customers throughout Roosendaal and the surrounding area. Every stop is an opportunity to provide excellent customer service by delivering orders on time, answering customer questions and ensuring every delivery is completed correctly. You also collect empty crates, process returns when necessary and verify age-restricted products according to Dutch regulations. At the end of your shift, you return to the depot, unload your van and report any important details before finishing your working day. Thanks to the changing routes and different customers, every day offers something new. What does a typical day look like? You drive different routes every shift and meet customers throughout Roosendaal and nearby towns. Do I need previous experience? No. You will receive full training, including three days working alongside an experienced buddy. Can I choose my schedule? Yes. You provide your availability and the planning team schedules your shifts accordingly. Functie eisen Grocery Delivery Driver Roosendaal | Independen
